items.title: Canonical ingress must be durably journaled before authoritative delivery
evidence: Production composition supplies StoreIngressJournal backed by Store.appendAuditEvent.
SQLite worker acknowledges append only after COMMIT; configured database uses WAL and synchronous=FULL.

A module-private Store capability checks the live worker database path, WAL mode, and synchronous=FULL; overriding the old public check method on Store(':memory:') does not grant a durable ingress capability.
CanonicalIngress rejects caller-supplied journals before creating or notifying a CommittedEnvelope.
test/platform/canonical-ingress-durability.test.mjs verifies memory-store rejection, arbitrary-journal rejection, commit-before-notification, and duplicate recognition after reopen.
Research cycle 134 added canonical_ingress_delivery_v1 as a SQLite outbox committed atomically with the canonical ingress event; recovery revalidates stored payloads before redispatch.

Crash-recovery test now proves pending delivery survives reopen and audit pruning, is replayed on duplicate submit, and is removed only after durable acknowledgement; delivered dedupe survives pruning.
Independent review found no transaction atomicity defect for fresh-format commit/ack, but identified unknown legacy delivery outcomes and non-durable Engine projection effects.
Research cycle 135 classifies pre-outbox rows as LEGACY_UNKNOWN, retains dedupe evidence, emits a durable uncertainty marker, and prevents unsafe automatic replay.
Targeted ingress durability and crash-recovery suites pass 6/6 after the migration change; the prior C1-C4 report is a snapshot and does not certify this modified source.
remaining: Delivery remains at-least-once: persist an idempotent Engine projection/checkpoint atomically with acknowledgement, or make replay a deterministic rebuild; test crashes after effect/before ack and after ack.
Pending records fail closed when compiler or validator versions drift; add a reviewed version registry or controlled migration and cross-version recovery tests.
items.nextAction: Design durable Engine projection recovery and versioned pending-event replay without weakening fail-closed verification.

items.title: Provider raw evidence is not uniformly wire-preserved
evidence: WebSocket path stores the received JSON-RPC frame bytes.

The alternate YellowstoneTruthBridge hashes a deterministic JSON projection of decoded signature, slot, and logs, explicitly labeled DECODED_PROTOBUF_JSON_CANONICAL. This bridge is not the live Feed.geyser ingestion path.

The unsafe rawWireBytes injection property was removed. Extra JavaScript properties, including empty, mismatched, or untrusted byte buffers, are ignored and cannot promote decoded evidence to wire capture.

Generic ContractCanary witnesses default to UNSPECIFIED for strings, objects, Buffer, and Uint8Array. Explicit representation labels distinguish JSON frames, canonical JSON, decoded protobuf JSON, and protobuf wire bytes; these are caller declarations, and a payload digest proves neither capture nor authenticity.
test/platform/yellowstone-truth-bridge.test.mjs and test/platform/contract-canary.test.mjs cover decoded digests, ignored untrusted bytes, and encoding defaults.
The real Feed.geyser in src/feed.ts receives decoded SDK updates and stores Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(update)); it does not retain pre-deserialization protobuf frames or use this alternate bridge.
remaining: Implement and independently review a trusted transport capture/decoder boundary that binds actual protobuf bytes to the event derived from those bytes.
Carry explicit representation metadata through the live Feed and canonical ingress archive; raw preservation is not uniform across providers.
No payload hash or encoding declaration establishes transaction authenticity, chain inclusion, or source identity.
items.nextAction: Design live Feed transport capture and event binding before claiming wire preservation; retain decoded provenance bounds until then.

items.title: Current truth validator does not independently prove Solana transaction authenticity
evidence: DefaultTruthValidator verifies payload digest and metadata shape.
signatureVerified is strictly false; authenticityProof is explicitly set to UNAVAILABLE_OBSERVATION_ONLY; inclusionProof is explicitly set to UNVERIFIED_LOG_DIGEST.
schemaCompliant is strictly false for generic/test compilers and true only for the versioned Solana compiler with decoded events.
restoreCommittedEnvelope verifies that replayed or recovered truth evidence strictly matches authenticityProof and inclusionProof.
Dependent authority remains gated at C4 static ceiling; unauthenticated observations cannot transition to live execution or capital authority.
test/platform/canonical-ingress-durability.test.mjs verifies fail-closed truth evidence and authenticity unavailability.
remaining: Cryptographic signature and finalized on-chain block inclusion verification require external anchor or multi-source RPC witness before claiming live chain truth.
items.nextAction: Maintain explicit authenticity unavailability and keep dependent live authority gated.

items.title: Engine still owns Feed construction, though its journal construction now fails closed
evidence: RuntimeComposition records Feed and CanonicalIngress references, and runEngine constructs and injects them paired into Engine.
Feed provides isIngressBound(port: unknown): boolean to verify ingress binding while preserving private field encapsulation.
composePaperRuntime enforces that injected Feed is paired with its bound CanonicalIngress, throwing FEED_REQUIRES_COMPOSITION_INGRESS and FEED_INGRESS_MISMATCH on violation.

Engine constructor validates that any injected Feed is paired with an explicit CanonicalIngress bound to the exact same instance before subscribing, throwing FEED_REQUIRES_COMPOSITION_INGRESS and FEED_INGRESS_MISMATCH.
Validation executes before registering any subscriber on the ingress, preventing phantom subscriptions on construction failure.
test/runtime-composition.test.mjs and test/c1-negative-compilation.test.mjs verify matched, mismatched, and missing Feed/ingress pairings.
items.nextAction: Maintain verified Feed/Ingress pairing across runtime composition entrypoints.

items.title: Committed ingress delivery is memory-only and can be lost or partially replayed
evidence: SQLite canonical_ingress_delivery_v1 persists the committed payload and acknowledgement state in the same database as the ingress audit journal.
Recovery on startup and duplicate submit revalidates and redispatches unacknowledged rows; pruning retains unacknowledged rows and stable dedupe records.
Engine projection checkpoint and delivery acknowledgement commit atomically in canonical_ingress_engine_projection_v1 under BEGIN IMMEDIATE.
Downstream Engine event handling is idempotent via stable event IDs in audit_event_dedupe.

test/platform/canonical-ingress-crash-recovery.test.mjs passes crash/reopen, prune-before-replay, replay, acknowledgement, prune-after-ack, crash after projection commit, and crash after in-memory effect before projection commit.
items.nextAction: Preserve atomic projection checkpointing across future downstream handlers.

items.title: Runtime telemetry requires authenticated attestation and a connected producer
evidence: C5 certify mode requires the fixed persisted artifact path with valid Ed25519 signature and pinned public key.

Implemented RuntimeTelemetryCapture (src/platform/ingress/runtime-telemetry.ts) bound to Store-backed ingress; captures V2 spans (compile, validate, commit, delivery), persists to SQLite before signing, and signs 32-byte root with pure Ed25519.
Implemented RuntimeTelemetryExporter (src/platform/ingress/runtime-telemetry-exporter.ts) in runEngine for periodic atomic publication and bounded shutdown drain.
Implemented verifyRuntimeTelemetryStoreBinding in scripts/runtime-telemetry-evidence.mjs; re-reads and independently verifies the exact unpruned SQLite audit row and spans.
Implemented AwsKmsRuntimeAttestationSigner (src/platform/ingress/aws-kms-runtime-attestation.ts) for dedicated AWS KMS pure Ed25519 signing with zero transaction/wallet APIs.
test/platform/runtime-telemetry-producer.test.mjs (10/10) and test/platform/aws-kms-runtime-attestation.test.mjs (11/11) pass with 100% assertions green.
remaining: Provision the production runtime attestation public key pin through reviewed deployment configuration.
Capture physical runtime artifact from actual paper deployment on provisioned host; C5-C10 remain gated until then.
